Elaine (Partnerships): Heads up team: SIs are asking for auto-claim on big net-new leads. We need a short, enforceable intake SLO and mapping rules by Mon. Thoughts?
Omar (Sales Ops): Agree we need rules. Current system had 60d cooldown which still caused swaps.
Reva (SI PM): Proposal: cooldown = 90 days for SI claims. Auto-claim criteria = net-new_est_arr >= 100000 AND match_score >= 0.82. Otherwise manual triage.
Sam (PartnerOps): Add exclusions: lead_origin in ["marketplace", "third_party_integrator"]. Also require `playbook_reference` and `validated_industry` on claim.
Omar (Sales Ops): Can we compute match_score from domain + CRM parent + fuzzy name? Sales should see raw signals so they can override.
Reva (SI PM): Yes. Surface signals: domain_match (T/F), crm_parent_match (T/F), fuzzy_name_score (0..1). Override requires `override_reason`. If override increases exposure > $250k, require manager sign-off.
Elaine (Partnerships): Legal check: intake should not require NDA. If lead marked `sensitive=true` route to SEs.
Sam (PartnerOps): Escalation: if SI claim not ACKed by assigned salesperson in 72h, auto-escalate to PartnerOps and ping #partnerships.ops. Add fields: si_claim_ts, si_claim_status.
ops-bot: Created PR: https://go.redwood.ai/pr/si-claim-routing-slo (tests included).
Sam (PartnerOps): Canary plan: roll to 50 EMEA accounts Tue 09:00 PST, monitor 48h for duplicate_claim_rate and time_to_ack. ops-bot will post daily summary.
Omar (Sales Ops): Quick CRM changes list?
Elaine (Partnerships): CRM fields to add: lead_origin, si_claim_ts, si_claim_status, match_score, override_reason, playbook_reference, sensitive. Defaults: excluded_origins = ["marketplace"], cooldown = 90d, auto-claim threshold = 100k.
Reva (SI PM): Require evidence for auto-claims >100k: buyer_domain, estimated_arr, contacts_count >= 2. If missing -> manual triage.
Sam (PartnerOps): Example intake CSV row we'll accept:
```
account_id,account_name,lead_origin,si_name,si_claim_ts,si_claim_status,match_score,estimated_arr,contacts_count,playbook_reference
54321,Polaris Inc,partner-referral,IntegratorY,2025-03-21T10:15:00Z,claimed,0.88,200000,3,PBK-42
```
Omar (Sales Ops): For overrides log who approved and timestamp. Also surface previous claim history to avoid flip-flops.
Elaine (Partnerships): TL;DR for doc: 90d cooldown, auto-claim rules (>=100k & match_score>=0.82), exclude marketplace, escalation after 72h, manager sign-off >250k, surface raw signals, require playbook + industry tag.
Reva (SI PM): I'll draft onboarding checklist and a one-pager for SIs.
Sam (PartnerOps): I'll merge the PR if no objections by EOD and schedule canary. Will post follow-up checklist + runbook. :thumbsup:
Elaine (Partnerships): Thanks all. If anything else pops up flag here. :eyes:
